description: This source file defines a Flutter widget class `LazyLoad` that implements deferred loading of expensive child widgets (such as network images) based on visibility and proximity to the viewport. It manages performance by delaying widget construction until necessary, using Flutter's scroll notifications and render object calculations.

classes.name: LazyLoad
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that wraps around content to defer its build until the widget is near or within the viewport, improving performance by avoiding unnecessary builds.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for this widget, returning an instance of `_LazyLoadState`.
